page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with no marginal notes. Running head at top, printed page number at top right. Catchword at bottom right, gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: nā[?] spe, velut sacra ancora subnixos, effice-re:eoque[?] nomine dissimillimam esse veteratoriae astutiae, quam sapientiam esse filij huius seculi opinantur.

7. Eximiam esse Dei benedictione, quam doin[?] rebus dubijs, subministrat fortes & consultos gubernatores. Vt enim tranquillo quilibet gubernator est: sed quum incu-buere venti & mare turbatum est, tum verò artis est gubernare nauim, & incolumes seruare nauigantes: sicturbata Repub. di-ctis[?] & arte regere animos & pectora mulcere, hoc opus hic labor est: ac tu maxime Respubl. docet virum. Sed ista nemo sine afflatu & ope diuina praestare potest.

§. Contra iusta Dei, reuelantis iram suam adversus impietatem & iniusticiam homi-num, maledictio est, quādo perturbata per Salamandras & Androclidas Repub. dat pueros principes, facitq; ut fœminæ do-minentur. Isa.3.4.12. Non loquitur Prophe-ta de ætate potissimum, & de sexu: sed de imprudentia & mollicie gubernatorū, qui nec togæ nec belli artibus pollent: destitu-ti bellica pariter & togata fortitudine, & u-triusque moderatrice prudentia. Exemplo sunt Rehabeam, Sedecias & multi alij sce-nici Principes, qui principum persona in Repub. nequaquam potuerunt tueri.

page.notes: Printed page number at head reads "75" (the 5 is slightly worn). Line 1: the first word appears as "nā" with a macron, and the "spe" may be read as "spe" with a long s; both are uncertain. "re:eoque" at the start of line 2 is doubtful: the first letter may be i (ideoque). "doin" at the start of the second line of paragraph 2 is doubtful. "tranquil lo" appears with a gap, read as tranquillo. The "ct" ligature in "benedictione" and "dictis" is set as a ligature and was read from context. The gathering signature is printed as "E 3" with an old-style 3. Catchword "Quotis-" is printed with a hyphen. Printed "Ifa" is read as Isa (long s).
